# Hologram Cam: wiring

<!-- Generated by `python -m cad.generate` from cad/products/cam.py. Edit the model, not this file. -->

Pin numbers are physical pin positions on the XIAO ESP32S3 Sense.
See `drawings/04_wiring.svg` for the schematic.

| Type | From | To | Notes |
|------|------|----|-------|
| power | LiPo cell `+` | Power switch `IN` | JST-SH or direct solder |
| power | Power switch `OUT` | XIAO ESP32S3 Sense BAT+ | through the left hinge and the brow channel |
| ground | LiPo cell `-` | XIAO ESP32S3 Sense BAT- | through the brow channel |
| power | Battery divider `IN` | XIAO ESP32S3 Sense BAT+ |  |
| analog | Battery divider `OUT` | XIAO ESP32S3 Sense pin 1 (GPIO1 D0 A0) | 200 k / 200 k divider, 100 nF to GND |
| ground | Battery divider `GND` | XIAO ESP32S3 Sense pin 13 (GND) |  |
| gpio | Privacy LED driver `CTRL` | XIAO ESP32S3 Sense pin 4 (GPIO4 D3) | 2N7002 gate, 100 k pull-down |
| power | Privacy LED driver `VBAT` | XIAO ESP32S3 Sense BAT+ | via 47 ohm to the LED anode |
| ground | Privacy LED driver `GND` | XIAO ESP32S3 Sense pin 13 (GND) |  |
| gpio | Capture button `A` | XIAO ESP32S3 Sense pin 2 (GPIO2 D1) | internal pull-up, active low |
| ground | Capture button `B` | XIAO ESP32S3 Sense pin 13 (GND) |  |
| touch | Touch pad `PAD` | XIAO ESP32S3 Sense pin 3 (GPIO3 D2 TOUCH3) | ESP32-S3 capacitive touch channel 3 |
| power | MAX98357A amp `VIN` | XIAO ESP32S3 Sense BAT+ |  |
| ground | MAX98357A amp `GND` | XIAO ESP32S3 Sense pin 13 (GND) |  |
| i2s | MAX98357A amp `BCLK` | XIAO ESP32S3 Sense pin 5 (GPIO5 D4) |  |
| i2s | MAX98357A amp `LRC` | XIAO ESP32S3 Sense pin 6 (GPIO6 D5) |  |
| i2s | MAX98357A amp `DIN` | XIAO ESP32S3 Sense pin 7 (GPIO43 D6) |  |
| gpio | MAX98357A amp `SD` | XIAO ESP32S3 Sense pin 8 (GPIO44 D7) | low = amp off (saves power when silent) |
| audio | MAX98357A amp `OUT+` | 1510 speaker `+` |  |
| audio | MAX98357A amp `OUT-` | 1510 speaker `-` |  |
| power | Charge contacts `+` | XIAO ESP32S3 Sense pin 14 (5V) | charges the LiPo through the XIAO |
| ground | Charge contacts `-` | XIAO ESP32S3 Sense pin 13 (GND) |  |
| video | Camera module `FPC` | XIAO ESP32S3 Sense CAM | 24-pin camera FPC through the right hinge |

## Where each module lives

| Module | Location |
|--------|----------|
| LiPo cell | Left temple |
| Power switch | Left temple |
| Battery divider | 200 k / 200 k + 100 nF |
| Privacy LED driver | Left endpiece |
| Capture button | Right temple |
| Touch pad | Right temple |
| MAX98357A amp | Right temple |
| 1510 speaker | Right temple |
| Charge contacts | Right temple |
| Camera module | Right endpiece |
